Primary surface-trigger check for the observed hidden-region failures. After solving, it compares each inferred member region against the allowed `choice_regions` and emits `UnexpectedHiddenRegion` when none match. It is less likely to be the root cause than `apply_member_constraint`, but it sits directly on the error path that turns a bad closure/member-constraint solution into the user-visible TAIT diagnostics seen in the reproducer.
